payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute for each index i the number of palindromes ending at i (l[i]) and starting at i (r[i]) via center expansion, then sum l[i]*r[j] for i<j.
payload.rationale: The solution uses complete search (center expansion) to count palindromes, but candidate subtypes are only DP. The rule suggests dp_2d_state; despite no 2D DP table, we follow the rule with low confidence.
